name: 502191a8d937
claim: lm_link.json stays in mode solo-local with peer_up=false and a rising consecutive_peer_failures counter even when the peer portal is reachable on 8443.

decisions.notes: lm_link.json showed mode=solo-local, peer_up=false, high consecutive_peer_failures while the Windows probe reached the Mac portal on 8443; the link does not self-heal.

rationale: Reachability alone does not flip the link out of solo-local; recovery needs an explicit link change, not just a successful probe.
